Just another reason for "gun control" to become another issue this election. Perfect timing.

This is such a bummer. I'm not looking forward to the shitstorm that's going to flare up about gun control and race around this, at this point I don't expect much productive to come from it. Pretty sure people are going to jump to use this as an excuse to argue whatever their viewpoint is without stopping to lament the fact that nine people are dead for no reason.
Don't you feel like it honours the people who died that people actively start looking for solutions to a nationwide problem such as the average psychopath being able to buy a gun.

It's a problem that needs some actual progress made on it, but nah I think it'd be disingenuous of me to say anything about honoring the dead. Could've been a bunch of cunts for all I know, but from the news coming out it just seems like an unhinged person murdered nine other people in a church. That's lamentable. The back and forth on gun control isn't advancing toward any solutions just because people bring it up after an event like this, if that was the case the problem would've been taken care of decades ago.
